dossier.headline: Heavyweights and IT cap gains; market slips after noon
dossier.summary: Through November 12, a shifting group of sectors and heavyweights held the market back: pharma, IT and autos in the morning, then IT, FMCG and autos at midday, with M&M, TCS and Nestle India named among the top losers. After noon both benchmarks turned slightly negative as IT stayed under pressure, while banks held firm.
why_it_matters: Losses in index heavyweights trimmed most of the late-morning gain
Sustained FII buying and lower crude were cited as support for the wider market
